title: OpenAI built a custom chip for ChatGPT
title_candidates: OpenAI named their first AI chip Jalapeño, and the test results are in
Why OpenAI built its own AI chip instead of buying one from someone else
OpenAI's Jalapeño chip just made every ChatGPT response faster than before
The AI chip OpenAI built from scratch is now running your ChatGPT requests
OpenAI's first homemade chip gets more out of every watt than anything before
caption:
OpenAI just turned on Jalapeño, their first ever custom-built AI chip, and the tests show it gets more intelligence out of every watt of power.

That translates directly to faster responses every time you use ChatGPT, running on hardware OpenAI designed themselves rather than built by someone else. Building your own chip means you control how the system improves, instead of waiting on external suppliers to catch up.

Every major chip company started somewhere. OpenAI just started.
